headlines.title_en: Economy expected to keep improving, innovating, and upgrading; industry anticipates timely RRR and rate cuts
headlines.summary_en: Driving sustained economic progress toward innovation, quality, and improvement; industry expects RRR cuts and rate cuts may be deployed in due course. The People's Bank of China recently held its 2026 H2 work conference, summarizing work since 2026, analyzing current conditions, and deploying next-stage tasks. The meeting emphasized implementing a moderately loose monetary policy, fully leveraging existing policy measures, promptly planning pragmatic incremental policies, stepping up counter-cyclical adjustment, boosting domestic demand, and optimizing supply, while solidly advancing key H2 priorities to drive sustained economic progress. Several experts expect there is room and possibility for RRR and rate cuts within the year.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: Banks' full-year absolute return potential to persist
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 4: CITIC Securities research report says, from a fundamental perspective, bank net interest margins are expected to perform well in Q2, with capital markets and wealth businesses driving fee income growth; under this backdrop, bank revenue growth remains stable and sound, with profit growth possibly rising slightly. From an investment perspective, the banking sector continued its positive trend since July last week, but index volatility was high amid market style shifts. CITIC Securities expects A-share volatility to remain elevated over the next two weeks, with the banking sector's relative returns possibly weakening; however, long-term narratives such as stable operating frameworks and macro dynamics continue to play out, and full-year absolute return potential remains.

headlines.title: 中信证券：政策或将持续利好特高压、配网智能化、储能、虚拟电厂等领域
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月4日讯，中信证券研报表示，2026年8月3日，国家发改委、能源局发布《新型电力系统建设“十五五”规划》。作为电力领域顶层文件，《规划》与《可再生能源“十五五”规划》《新型能源体系建设“十五五”规划》等形成配套，以“源网荷储”一体化协同为主线，推动电力行业从单一新增新能源装机转向全域统筹。《规划》围绕电源、电网、调节资源、负荷、市场等设置量化目标，力争2030年初步建成新型电力系统，非化石能源发电量占比升至50%。中信证券认为，政策或将持续利好特高压、配网智能化、各类储能、虚拟电厂等灵活调节资源、清洁电源开发及电力数字化领域，并加速容量补偿机制

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: Policies likely to continue benefiting UHV, distribution grid intelligence, energy storage, virtual power plants, and more
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 4: CITIC Securities research report says that on August 3, 2026, the National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration released the "15th Five-Year Plan for New Power System Construction." As a top-level document for the power sector, the Plan complements the "15th Five-Year Plan for Renewable Energy" and the "15th Five-Year Plan for New Energy System Construction," centering on coordinated "source-grid-load-storage" integration to shift the power industry from solely adding new renewable capacity to holistic planning. The Plan sets quantitative targets across power sources, grids, regulation resources, loads, and markets, aiming to preliminarily build a new power system by 2030, with non-fossil energy power generation share rising to 50%. CITIC Securities believes policies may continue to benefit UHV, distribution grid intelligence, various energy storage, flexible regulation resources like virtual power plants, clean power development, and power digitalization, while accelerating capacity compensation mechanisms.

headlines.title: 中国即将发行或正在发行的国债和政策性金融债
headlines.summary: 【推动经济持续向新向优向好发展 业界预计降准降息可能适时启用】日前，中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议，总结2026年以来工作，分析当前形势，部署下一阶段工作。会议强调，实施好适度宽松的货币政策，充分发挥各项存量政策效能，及时谋划出台务实管用的增量政策，加大逆周期调节力度，加力扩大内需、优化供给，扎实做好下半年各项重点工作，推动经济持续向新向优向好发展。多位专家预计，年内降准降息有一定可能和空间。

headlines.title: 风险逐步释放，公募基金新发热情升温
headlines.summary: 公募基金发行持续回暖。公募排排网统计数据显示，按认购起始日统计，本周（8月3日-8月9日），全市场共计有29家公募机构有产品发行，合计发行产品35只，环比上周增幅达118.75%，数量创下近三周新高。从投资类型来看，权益类基金占据主导地位，本周开启募集的权益类基金有21只，占总量的60%。业内人士认为，市场风险得到一定程度释放之后，公募布局热情有所回升。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Risks gradually unwind, public fund issuance enthusiasm warms up
headlines.summary_en: Public fund issuance continues to recover. According to PaiPaiWang statistics, by subscription start date, this week (August 3-9), 29 public fund institutions have products launching, with 35 products in total, up 118.75% week-on-week, hitting a three-week high. By investment type, equity funds dominate, with 21 equity funds starting subscription this week, accounting for 60% of the total. Industry insiders believe that after market risks have been partly released, public fund deployment enthusiasm has rebounded. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: “创新+出海”驱动，A股生物医药公司盈利能力提升
headlines.summary: 2026年上半年，A股生物医药公司整体盈利能力显著提升，在韧性发展中交出亮眼的成绩单，创新驱动与国内外市场拓展成为业绩增长的核心动力。截至8月3日，104家A股生物医药公司披露了上半年业绩情况（含半年报、业绩预告等）。从预告净利润增幅下限来看，有67家公司预计净利润增长（包括扭亏、减亏）。此外，药明康德、沃华医药、泽璟制药等10家公司披露半年报，其中7家实现净利润同比增长或扭亏。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: 'Innovation plus going global' drives profitability improvement for A-share biopharma firms
headlines.summary_en: In H1 2026, A-share biopharmaceutical companies saw significantly improved overall profitability, delivering strong results amid resilient development, with innovation-driven growth and domestic and international market expansion as core drivers. As of August 3, 104 A-share biopharma companies disclosed H1 performance (including interim reports and earnings forecasts). Based on lower bounds of forecast net profit changes, 67 companies expect profit growth (including turning losses around or narrowing losses). Additionally, 10 companies including WuXi AppTec, Wohua Pharmaceutical, and Zelgen Pharmaceuticals disclosed interim reports, with 7 achieving year-on-year net profit growth or turning losses around. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 美国中长期国债收益率跌超4个基点
headlines.summary: 周一（8月3日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期国债收益率跌4.90个基点，报4.6857%，整体窄幅震荡于4.68%附近、北京时间20:02刷新日低至4.6674%。 两年期美债收益率涨3.72个基点，报4.2518%；30年期美债收益率跌4.19个基点，报5.2295%，整体持续低位窄幅震荡。 2/10年期美债收益率利差跌0.373个基点，报+43.185个基点。 10年期通胀保值国债（TIPS）收益率跌2.05个基点，至2.4265%；两年期TIPS收益率涨1.02个基点，至2.0968%；30年期TIPS收益率跌3.19个基点，至3.0031%。

headlines.title_en: US medium- and long-term Treasury yields fall more than 4 basis points
headlines.summary_en: Monday (August 3) New York close: US 10-year Treasury yield fell 4.90 bps to 4.6857%, trading narrowly around 4.68%, hitting a daily low of 4.6674% at 20:02 Beijing time. 2-year Treasury yield rose 3.72 bps to 4.2518%; 30-year Treasury yield fell 4.19 bps to 5.2295%, remaining low and narrowly rangebound. 2/10-year yield spread fell 0.373 bps to +43.185 bps. 10-year TIPS yield fell 2.05 bps to 2.4265%; 2-year TIPS yield rose 1.02 bps to 2.0968%; 30-year TIPS yield fell 3.19 bps to 3.0031%.
